title: Data Analyst
description:
An established, market-leading property services business is growing its in-house data analytics team and looking for a Data Analyst to play a key part in how the business uses its data.


This isn’t a role where you sit and build reports to a spec. You’ll work closely with teams across the business to understand how they use data today, spot where things could work better, and design and deliver the solutions. It’s a hands-on role that mixes data analysis with business analysis, in a small team where your input will shape how things are done.


The business is partway through rolling out a data lake on Microsoft Fabric, so this is a great time to join and help shape the platform.


What you’ll be doing

  • Building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including data models and DAX measures
  • Working with stakeholders to understand how they use data and where processes can be improved
  • Writing SQL to query, shape and analyse data from a range of sources
  • Contributing to the Microsoft Fabric rollout (lakehouse, warehouse, OneLake)
  • Presenting findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including clients
  • Supporting and guiding junior members of the team


What you’ll bring

  • Around 2 to 3 years’ experience in a data analyst or similar role
  • Strong Power BI skills, including DAX and data modelling (star schema, fact and dimension tables)
  • Good SQL skills
  • Advanced Excel (Power Query, pivots, lookups)
  • A proactive, curious approach, with the confidence to engage with people across the business
  • Good communication skills and a comfortable manner in front of clients



Nice to have

  • Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience (lakehouses, medallion architecture, Spark SQL)
  • Experience with AI tools or agents
  • Geographical mapping in Power BI
  • A background in property, real estate or professional services
  • Some VBA awareness


If this sounds like you, click apply and send your CV. I’ll be in touch to talk you through the role in more detail.
